note: Step A / Golden Path: visit and test cards (including cards from a doctor's instruction), rules G0 and G1, caregiver copy when consented, button replies update cards and free text opens a handover, tasks for people. v1.1: the Use Case 2T v1.4 test cycle (test reminder, report check with three buttons, upload request and nudge, outside-report score and routing in Shadow, the doctor's report review). v1.2: Voice Triage MVP-lite: a health message brings the acknowledgement and an automated call (10 questions in the patient's language: Tamil, Hindi or Telugu); Red, Amber or Green by plain rules. v1.3: Savitri Patil speaks Hindi and Nirmala Reddy Telugu; Lakshmi V. stays Tamil; voice notes HI-04 and TE-01.

demo_cases.title: Already booked
demo_cases.steps: When the T-7 reminder arrives, the patient taps "… booked" on it. The DEXA card shows Booked with that date.

demo_cases.title: Help me book
demo_cases.steps: The patient taps "Please help me book" on the reminder, then one of the four slots. The DEXA card shows Booked with that date and time.

demo_cases.title: Booked elsewhere
demo_cases.steps: The patient taps "Booked elsewhere" on the reminder. CarePilot asks for the report once it is available; send it from Messages to finish the case.

demo_cases.title: No response, the agent calls and books
demo_cases.steps: Tap and type nothing as this patient. 48 hours after the reminder, Simulate call shows on the DEXA card, set to S2 (the agent books).

demo_cases.title: No response, the agent calls: safety stop
demo_cases.steps: Tap and type nothing as this patient. 48 hours after the reminder, Simulate call shows on the DEXA card, set to S3 (the patient mentions pain: safety stop).
